name: Script accent underline
looks: A short serif or display headline types on character by character with a blinking cursor, in a warm, editorial voice. The one emphasised word switches to a loose cursive script face as it lands, and a hand-drawn underline swash draws itself beneath that word a beat later.
build: The headline types on with kit.typeOn, one voice, with a blinking ::after cursor. The emphasised word is a separate span in a script font, landing with the same typing rhythm. The underline is an SVG path under the word, revealed with strokeDashoffset, hand-wobbled, drawn after the word finishes on power2.out.
sound: A soft typewriter clack per character, and a light pen-on-paper swish under the underline draw.
prompt: Type on a short, warm headline in a serif voice with a blinking cursor, letting the one word the shot is about switch to a cursive script face and gain a hand-drawn underline swash as it lands, so the line feels personal rather than corporate.
source: a Momwise parenting-app hype video in prompt-motion.com's gallery (prompt-motion.com/francoxavier33-d2dfd2), studied 2026-10-09
